summary: Frontend-only static website testing for Impress Print premium printing site. Verified routing, header sticky/glass-dark effect on scroll, animated counters (Indonesian locale format: 5.000, 50.000), WhatsApp floating button + panel, hero CTA, portfolio filters & case study modal, contact form submission via wa.me, FAQ expand/collapse, services page (8 items), mobile menu. All flows working. No console errors detected. WhatsApp number 6282219281947 verified in all CTAs.

issues: The Emergent 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps the floating WhatsApp toggle button area (both positioned bottom-right). In test environment elementFromPoint at WA button center returns the emergent-badge. Real-user impact: a click slightly inside the badge area will hit the badge link instead of WA toggle. Consider increasing WA button bottom-offset (e.g., bottom-20 instead of bottom-6) to clear the badge.

action_items: Optional UX improvement: Move WhatsApp floating button up (e.g., bottom-24/right-6) so it does not overlap the Emergent platform badge in the bottom-right corner. Currently bottom-6 right-6 overlaps with the injected 'Made with Emergent' badge.
critical_code_review_comments: All page components (Home, Services, Portfolio, About, Contact) have proper data-testid coverage for interactive elements - good.
WhatsApp integration is consistent across components - all use contactInfo.whatsapp from mock.js (single source of truth).
AnimatedCounter uses Intl 'id-ID' locale formatting which displays 5.000 / 50.000 - correct for Indonesian audience.
No backend exists (pure static SPA with mock data) - matches problem statement.
No console errors or React warnings observed during testing across all pages.
seed_data_creation: None - all data is static in /app/frontend/src/mock.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure static frontend with mock.js. All Playwright clicks on the floating WhatsApp toggle button must use page.evaluate JS click or page.mouse.click at the button's bounding box center - regular locator.click(force=True) fails because the 'Made with Emergent' badge in the bottom-right corner intercepts pointer events. The button itself works fine (verified via JS click and mouse.click). When testing contact form submission, override window.open with `window._openedUrls=[]; window.open=(u)=>{window._openedUrls.push(u);}` because the submit calls window.open(wa.me/...) which playwright's expect_page() does not always catch.
